tiers.name: Swing trader product
tiers.track_profile: One CN anchor journey. Shared tools retain track-neutral contracts; the already enumerated HK/US source packages prove their exact bounded operations without duplicating the whole swing journey.
tiers.product_outcome: A CN swing trader can select an exact listing; acquire supported daily market, calendar, rule, universe, event, classification, and provenance inputs; screen and inspect it; calculate technicals; create and simulate a plan; and resume an auditable journal-backed review loop. Exact HK/US input operations remain separately labelled capabilities, not duplicate role products.

blockers.exit: The named CN-anchor daily quote/OHLCV path documents exact identity, latency, adjustment, session/completeness, correction, entitlement/licence, fixture/output rights, budgets, cancellation, and source authority. Existing HK/US tools retain focused bounded contracts but do not block the CN role journey.
At least one supported point-in-time universe path and the required calendar, rule, earnings, corporate-action, classification, and news/event paths have the same source and rights evidence.

The Session 45 swing journey is updated to use only named repeatable inputs, compact/drill-down receipts, explicit failure recovery, portable journal state, and no ad hoc caller-attested market packet.

tiers.name: Long-term equity investor product
tiers.track_profile: One US/SEC anchor journey. CN/HK proposals prove their market-owned source and calculation contracts inside the same tier; they do not create two more investor-product acceptance matrices.
tiers.product_outcome: A US long-term investor can complete a cited company review from original filings and exact accounting/ownership/event evidence through normalized fundamentals, comparisons, valuation, quality/growth, governance, thesis, and a reproducible research report. CN/HK capabilities remain exact and isolated without duplicating the full journey.

blockers.exit: Named CNINFO/exchange/HKEX/SEC document and attachment paths prove exact identity, filing scope, language/correction lineage, bounded retrieval, licence, fixture, OCR/PDF, and output rights.
Named transcript, guidance, estimate, governance, ownership, industry, sentiment, and A/H comparison inputs document authority, timing, coverage, corrections, licence, and output rights.
The Session 45 long-term-investor journey runs entirely from T1 ProductUseful receipts and supported primary/company-intelligence inputs through cited report and thesis review.

tiers.name: Portfolio manager and monitoring product
tiers.track_profile: One mixed portfolio/import journey whose CN, HK, and US legs remain separately labelled; no per-track portfolio product or repeated journey.
tiers.product_outcome: A portfolio owner or manager can import and reconcile holdings, calculate risk/scenario/attribution/rebalance/tax-lot facts, define durable company and portfolio monitors, receive separately authorized alerts, resume across sessions, and audit every state and notification event.

blockers.exit: One user-owned durable storage adapter proves idempotency, concurrency, correction lineage, retention, export/import, privacy, reload, fork, and recovery.
One separately authorized notification path has bounded delivery, retry/idempotency, privacy, incident, and observable failure semantics.
At least one repeatable bounded portfolio input path proves identity, currency, lot, reconciliation, privacy, correction, and refresh behavior end to end.

tiers.name: Quant researcher product
tiers.track_profile: One US point-in-time dataset/replay anchor journey. Provider-neutral manifests preserve other declared tracks without three separate quant acceptance runs.
tiers.product_outcome: A quant researcher can bind a point-in-time universe and dataset, calculate explicit market/factor/event features, execute bounded replay and backtests, compare declared trials, and reproduce the complete run from canonical manifests without survivorship, vintage, or experiment-ledger ambiguity.

blockers.exit: One supported US-anchor point-in-time universe/dataset path proves membership, vintages, corrections, completeness limits, fixture/output rights, and reproducible replay. Other declared tracks retain exact labels without requiring duplicate quant journeys.
The Session 45 quant journey runs from supported T1 receipts through hypothesis, feature/event calculation, trial ledger, backtest, comparison, chart/table, and reproduction export.

tiers.name: Macro and multi-asset researcher product
tiers.track_profile: Global and cross-market labelled legs, not an equity track. CN-specific instruments remain explicit source legs and never create cn/hk/us product variants.
tiers.product_outcome: A multi-asset researcher can identify exact fund, bond, convertible, option, future, commodity, crypto, macro, rate, and FX legs; acquire supported source evidence; run the reviewed calculations; and compose separately labelled global comparisons without equity-track leakage.

blockers.exit: Every instrument family has at least one named supported acquisition/import path with identity, symbology, timestamps, coverage, correction/completeness, entitlement/licence, fixture, and output-right evidence.
Fund/share-class, fixed-income, convertible, option, futures, crypto, macro-release, and FX terms come from dated authoritative or explicitly bounded sources.
A complete researcher journey proves exact instrument legs, calculations, timing alignment, revisions, separately labelled comparisons, drill-down, and failure recovery.

tiers.name: Day trader and execution operator product
tiers.track_profile: One US live-session and broker anchor journey, plus the single CN tape-adapter contract required by Session 41. No duplicated HK or CN end-to-end day/broker journey.
tiers.product_outcome: A day trader can acquire and inspect authenticated live quote/depth/tape evidence, run a bounded session workflow, plan and simulate action, observe accounts, paper trade, evaluate compliance facts, and—only after every live gate—submit explicitly authorized orders with reconciliation, incidents, duplicate-exposure representation, and complete audit receipts.

blockers.exit: At minimum the reviewed credentialed Alpaca US real-time and documented-latency Eastmoney CN paths prove sequence domains, gaps/resets, corrections/cancels/busts, three clocks, conditions, entitlement, licence, fixtures, and bounded acquisition.
The injected bounded streaming capability proves cancellation, reconnect/reset behavior, backpressure, byte/event budgets, stale-completion rejection, and shutdown.
Named Alpaca, IBKR, and CN broker account/API agreements, capabilities, credentials, entitlements, host/method allowlists, pacing, and account/jurisdiction rules are evidenced.
Credential custody, per-order authorization, idempotency, reconciliation, kill/disable controls, observability, privacy, incident response, and ambiguous-submission force-resume behavior pass review.
Prolonged paper operation and failure-injection evidence satisfies Sessions 25 and 44 before any live mutation lane is enabled.
